what: AT-35-E6-001 cycle 4 -- the corpus-wide before/after comparison for retiring the run-time source-format formula evaluator in favour of the ingest-converted Expr fold.
re_derive: AT35_E6_VARCHAIN_DUMP=<path> cargo test --locked --lib -j 6 -- --ignored class_feature_grant_consumer::tests::dump_the_whole_var_chain_population  (run at the pre-swap commit and at HEAD, then diff)

probes: spread (Str1 Dex2 Con3 Int4 Wis5 Cha6)

mechanism: Every moved value is one mechanism: identifier CASE. The retired evaluator looked a variable name up by exact bytes, so a corpus row writing RogueLvl where the class declares RogueLVL (or classlevel("bard") where the class is Bard) silently answered 0. Variable and class names are case-insensitive in the rule source, and the converted package mints one opaque id per case-folded name, so they now bind. Each moved value was spot-checked against the published rule; in every case checked the new value is the rulebook's and the old one was a silent 0.

records_only_before_note: These records' every target was refused by the formula parser before AND after (skillinfo("RANK"), count(...), var("CL=<class>"), charbonusto(...)). They resolved 0 values before the swap; the artifact simply no longer carries a chain that never evaluated. Confirmed: resolved_values_inside_records_only_before = 0.
